name: toc
title: Table of Contents
description: Tracks headings in a scroll container, highlights the active section while scrolling, and smooth-scrolls to a heading on click.
usageSnippet:
static const items = [ { value: "introduction", depth: 2, label: "Introduction" }, { value: "usage", depth: 2, label: "Usage" }, ];

Introduction

Usage

scrollContainer()/>

props.name: items
props.description: The TOC items with `value` (slug/id) and `depth` (heading level).

props.name: autoScroll
props.description:
Whether to auto-scroll the TOC container so the first active item
is visible when active headings change.

props.name: defaultActiveIds
props.description:
The default active heading ids when rendered.
Use when you don't need to control the active headings.

props.name: getRootNode
props.description: A root node to correctly resolve document in custom environments. E.x.: Iframes, Electron.

props.name: ids
props.description: The ids of the elements in the TOC. Useful for composition.

props.name: rootMargin
props.description:
The root margin for the IntersectionObserver.
Controls the effective viewport area for determining active headings.

props.name: scrollBehavior
props.description:
The default scroll behavior used when auto-scrolling the TOC container
and when scrolling to a heading (via link click or `api.scrollTo`).
Can be overridden per-call by passing `behavior` to `api.scrollTo`.

props.name: scrollEl
props.description:
Function that returns the scroll container element to observe within.
Defaults to the document/viewport.

props.name: threshold
props.description:
The IntersectionObserver threshold. A value of `0` means the heading is
active as soon as even one pixel is visible within the root margin area.

events.name: onActiveChange
events.description: Callback when the active (visible) headings change.

examples.source:
import Toc from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/toc/toc.marko"; static const items = [ { value: "demo-introduction", depth: 2, label: "Introduction" }, { value: "demo-installation", depth: 2, label: "Installation" }, { value: "demo-usage", depth: 2, label: "Usage" }, { value: "demo-api-reference", depth: 2, label: "API reference" }, { value: "demo-faq", depth: 2, label: "FAQ" }, ];

Introduction

Scroll this panel and watch the table of contents on the right track which section is currently in view.

Installation

Components are added to your project with the CLI, which copies the source files directly into your own registry directory so you can edit them freely.

Usage

Import the component, pass it your heading list and the scroll container to observe, and it takes care of the rest.

API reference

Every prop mirrors the underlying Zag machine, plus a small set of additive sugar props.

FAQ

Common questions about theming and accessibility are answered on the main site.

scrollContainer() class="sticky top-6 self-start" />
examples.description: A table of contents tracking headings inside a scrollable panel.

import Toc from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/toc/toc.marko"; static const items = [ { value: "overview", depth: 2, label: "Overview" }, { value: "getting-started", depth: 2, label: "Getting started" }, { value: "examples", depth: 2, label: "Examples" }, ];

Overview

Pass a title to render a heading above the list of links.

Getting started

The title is rendered from the machine's own title part, so it participates in the same accessibility wiring as the rest of the nav.

Examples

Scroll to see the active link update as each heading enters view.

scrollContainer() title="On this page" class="sticky top-6 self-start" />
examples.description: Pass `title` to render a heading above the list of links.

import Toc from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/toc/toc.marko"; static const items = [ { value: "installation", depth: 2, label: "Installation" }, { value: "prerequisites", depth: 3, label: "Prerequisites" }, { value: "quick-start", depth: 3, label: "Quick start" }, { value: "usage", depth: 2, label: "Usage" }, { value: "basic-example", depth: 3, label: "Basic example" }, { value: "advanced-example", depth: 3, label: "Advanced example" }, ];

Installation

Deeper headings indent further in the list, driven entirely by each item's depth.

Prerequisites

You will need a Marko 6 project with Tailwind CSS and the marko-ui adapter installed.

Quick start

Run the CLI command for the component you want and import it into your route.

Usage

Every interactive component follows the same one-tag wiring pattern: <zag> picks the machine's props, creates and connects the service, and returns the api getter.

Basic example

Import the component, pass the required props, and render it like any other tag.

Advanced example

Controlled usage is supported throughout the registry.

scrollContainer() class="sticky top-6 self-start" />
examples.description: Each item's `depth` controls its indentation, so `h2`/`h3` outlines nest naturally.

examples.title: Controlled
examples.source:
import Toc from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/toc/toc.marko"; static const items = [ { value: "one", depth: 2, label: "Section one" }, { value: "two", depth: 2, label: "Section two" }, { value: "three", depth: 2, label: "Section three" }, ];

Section one

Listen for activeIdsChange to read which headings are currently active, without taking over control of the list.

Section two

The active heading below reflects the same value the indicator bar is tracking.

Section three

Scroll to the bottom to see the active id list update.

scrollContainer() activeIdsChange=(next) => { activeIds = next; } /> active: ${activeIds.join(", ") || "none"}
examples.description: Listen for `activeIdsChange` (or `onActiveChange` for the full details) to read the active headings without taking over control of the list.
